---
title: "SVHM ICU Publications Dashboard"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
editor: visual
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

# Shared plot theme
plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 11)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Load data
# ----------------------------
pubs_all    <- read_csv("data/pubs_all.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
pubs_latest <- read_csv("data/pubs_latest.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ----------------------------
# Parse PubMed sort date
# ----------------------------
parse_sort_date <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "/", "-")
  x <- ifelse(
    grepl("^\\d{8}$", x),
    paste0(substr(x, 1, 4), "-", substr(x, 5, 6), "-", substr(x, 7, 8)),
    x
  )
  suppressWarnings(as.Date(x))
}

pubs_all <- pubs_all %>%
  mutate(
    sort_date = parse_sort_date(sortpubdate),
    pub_year  = year(sort_date),
    month     = floor_date(sort_date, "month"),
    Title     = ifelse(
      !is.na(pubmed_url) & pubmed_url != "",
      paste0("<a href='", pubmed_url, "' target='_blank'>", title, "</a>"),
      title
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sort_date))

pubs_latest <- pubs_latest %>%
  mutate(
    sort_date = parse_sort_date(sortpubdate),
    Title     = ifelse(
      !is.na(pubmed_url) & pubmed_url != "",
      paste0("<a href='", pubmed_url, "' target='_blank'>", title, "</a>"),
      title
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# METRICS
# ============================================================

last_complete_year <- year(Sys.Date()) - 1

total_last_year <- pubs_all %>%
  filter(pub_year == last_complete_year) %>%
  nrow()

monthly <- pubs_all %>%
  count(month, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(month) %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative = cumsum(n),
    roll12 = if (n() >= 12) rollapply(n, 12, sum, align = "right", fill = NA) else NA_real_
  )

latest_12m_total <- tail(na.omit(monthly$roll12), 1)
latest_12m_total <- if (length(latest_12m_total) == 1) latest_12m_total else NA_real_
```

```{r kpi, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
kpi_style <- "
font-size:1.6em;
font-weight:bold;
padding:0.75em;
background-color:#f5f5f5;
border-radius:8px;
margin-bottom:0.75em;
"

kpi_html <- sprintf(
  "<div style='display:flex;gap:1em;flex-wrap:wrap;'>
     <div style='%s;flex:1;min-width:280px;'>
       Publications in the last 12 months: %s
     </div>
     <div style='%s;flex:1;min-width:280px;'>
       Total publications in %s: %s
     </div>
   </div>",
  kpi_style,
  ifelse(is.na(latest_12m_total), 'NA', latest_12m_total),
  kpi_style,
  last_complete_year,
  total_last_year
)

knitr::asis_output(kpi_html)
```

```{r monthly_chart, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

monthly_last_year <- monthly %>%
  filter(year(month) == last_complete_year)

if (nrow(monthly_last_year) > 0) {
  ggplot(monthly_last_year, aes(x = month, y = n)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Publications per Month (", last_complete_year, ")"),
      x = "Month",
      y = "Number of publications"
    ) +
    plot_theme
} else {
  cat(paste0("No publications found for ", last_complete_year, ".\n\n"))
}
```

```{r cumulative_chart, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = cumulative)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative publications over time",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Cumulative publications"
  ) +
  plot_theme
```

### Newest publications

```{r latest_table, echo=FALSE}
datatable(
  pubs_latest %>%
    arrange(desc(sort_date), title) %>%
    transmute(
      `Publication date` = pubdate,
      `First author`     = first_author,
      Title              = Title
    ),
  escape   = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options  = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE)
)
```

### All publications

```{r all_table, echo=FALSE}
datatable(
  pubs_all %>%
    arrange(desc(sort_date), title) %>%
    transmute(
      `Publication date` = pubdate,
      `First author`     = first_author,
      Title              = Title
    ),
  escape   = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options  = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE)
)
```
